bestBets.overview: Track rated soft 6 at the time of acceptances and showers are forecast. WINGS OF DESTINY led them up at Balaklava last time only to be grabbed late by Regimented. She has drawn well in gate 3 and has Jason Holder to ride. BLAZING RED worked home from back in the field to finish a close second to Goodlookin' Guru at Murray Bridge third-up when rising to this trip. WINNING ALL ROUND had good form early last campaign, placing at his first three runs. ELROND was one-paced in the run to the line in town last start and may improve stepping up to this journey.

raceTips.comment: Wings Of Destiny was placed at Balaklava two runs back behind Healthandhappiness before she led when 2nd behind Regimented there last time. Blazing Red was good at Murray Bridge last time when 2nd behind Goodlookin’ Guru. Winning All Round was placed at his first three and has a trial and jump-out under his belt. Fomenter is on debut for Michael Hickmott and has trialled and jumped-out OK. Empire Ruler and Goldfields Grey are now with Luke O’Connor.

The rise to 1200m looks ideal and he's likely to have taken benefit from the race experience. MY CHERIE AMOR was placed over this trip at Balaklava in June. She can take up a position handy to the speed from a good draw. LUNAR VISTA was put away after running second over 1500m at Gawler in April. He has raced well over this trip in the past. bestBets.overview: KALOSYNI had no favours when midfield behind Zenacity here two starts ago. Efforts either side of that have been good and this race isn't any harder. DREAMS FULFILLED hasn't managed a win since November 2024 but he has finished in the placings in two of his past three outings. LADY ZELDA, DRAGONFACE and CHUR NIBBLE are other chances.

raceTips.comment: Classy Claret was a Murray Bridge winner in Feb and hasn’t raced since being beaten 2.68 lengths in 5th behind Savsonic at Oakbank. He gets in nicely here after the 4kg claim. Stablemate Dreams Fulfilled comes back in classs and should be in the mix. Lady Zelda was good making ground in 3rd behind Leading Impact here. Dragonface was good behind Full Commitment here last time out. Kalosyni was OK when 4th behind She’s Ternacious at Murray Bridge last time. So Grand has been runner-up at her past two.
